proposals: CPCB should publish an annual national PET collection and recovery figure with a stated method, so that the 90–95% recovery rate repeated across sources becomes a single audited statistic instead of competing industry estimates.

CPCB should publish, by producer category, the recycled content actually certified on the EPR portal each year against the Schedule II targets, so that progress from 30% to 60% for Category I rigid packaging can be checked rather than assumed.

The Environment Ministry should require recyclers on the EPR portal to record the tonnage of PET bought from informal collectors and aggregators, so that the flow from kabadiwala collection into QR-tracked, certified supply chains is measured and the informal network appears in the ledger.

FSSAI should publish the list of authorised food-grade rPET plants with authorised capacity and annual output, so that the roughly 3 lakh tonnes a year unlocked in March 2026 can be checked against the 40% food-grade PET mandate.
